text: つべこべ　いわずに　あいて　しな

structure.jp: つべこべ　いわずに

patterns.name: 〜ずに
patterns.explanation: ずに on a verb means 'without doing' it, the same as ないで. つべこべ いわずに = 'without griping'.

patterns.name: 〜なさい
patterns.explanation: しな is the short, rough form of しなさい, an order to do something. あいて しな = 'take me on'.
